literals: [ASR][FinalCommit] skip pasteboard handoff, reason=changedAfterPaste, trigger=smartOrganizeUndoCopy, seq=
retainedNativeEvidence.observed: With a restore snapshot and a recorded written change count, the function increments the restore token, cancels and clears the scheduled restore DispatchWorkItem, then compares NSPasteboard.generalPasteboard.changeCount with the recorded count: equal logs a handoff, different logs a skip with reason changedAfterPaste.

Before posting Command-V the delayed paste proceeds only if the session is unchanged, asrFinalGeneration_ equals the captured generation, a paste is in flight, Command-V has not been posted, asrFinalTextWriteCount_ is zero and asrPasteCommitSeq_ equals the captured sequence; otherwise it logs staleBeforeCommandV. When the host bundle identifier equals com.microsoft.Excel and NSEvent.pressedMouseButtons is non-zero, the commit waits for mouse release. Named failure reasons cover target change before post, pasteboard change during write and pasteboard write failures; a posted paste is logged with hostAck=unknown.

A host commit resolution with the values hostCommitted, imeCommitRequired, ambiguous and contextInvalid is evaluated before delivery; resolutions that are not hostCommitted return early. On the path that logs strategy skipSystemCommitted with zero writes (reason hostCommittedOriginal), the function increments asrFinalGeneration_, resets asrFinalTextWriteCount_ and stores 2 in asrFinalCommitStrategy_. It also reads a host text-implementation classification (asrAXInputImplementation_) whose inline names include web and qt.
